name: hold point
wording: passed only on the operator's sign-off; exactly: a user story's read-back; its plan read-back, unless a task with no story; a change the operator asked to review before it joins; release; a fork irreversible, about value or beyond the architect's competence; any point the operator calls, stop included
reason: The operator: a large residue has a real cause, a more precise name, a fused concept, or relations, procedure or implementation restated where they don't belong; each is resolved by that cause, each relation stated once in the concept owning it, and a concept counts as new only where no established name covers it. Named hold point, the more precise established name, in place of approval gate.
